property.label: Category Id
property.name: id
property.description: The Id of the Category that controls the data shown. Use a data expression for proper function.

property.label: Image Link
property.name: imageUrl
property.description: The link to the image that is displayed in the category card.

property.label: Image Alternate Text
property.name: imageAlt
property.description: The alternate/descriptor text for the image. Displays on hover of the image and when read by screenreaders

property.label: CTA Link
property.name: ctaUrl
property.description: The link/href that the user will be navigated to when the link is clicked.

property.label: CTA Display Text
property.name: ctaText
property.description: The text that will be displayed for the clickable link.
